rules.title: Java 9 and 10 are no longer supported
rules.summary: The Oracle Java SE Support Roadmap lists Java 9 and 10 as non-LTS releases whose Premier Support ended between March 2018 and September 2018. It says a previous non-LTS release is superseded once a new feature release is made available.

rules.title: Java 12 to 16 are no longer supported
rules.summary: The Oracle Java SE Support Roadmap lists Java 12 to 16 as non-LTS releases whose Premier Support ended between September 2019 and September 2021. It says a previous non-LTS release is superseded once a new feature release is made available. The Eclipse Temurin support page lists Java 16 as EOSL, with end of availability in September 2021.

rules.title: Java 18 to 20 are no longer supported
rules.summary: The Oracle Java SE Support Roadmap lists Java 18 to 20 as non-LTS releases whose Premier Support ended between September 2022 and September 2023. It says a previous non-LTS release is superseded once a new feature release is made available. The Eclipse Temurin support page lists Java 18, 19, and 20 as EOSL, with end of availability in September 2022, March 2023, and September 2023.

rules.title: Java 22 to 24 are no longer supported
rules.summary: The Oracle Java SE Support Roadmap lists Java 22 to 24 as non-LTS releases whose Premier Support ended between September 2024 and September 2025. It says a previous non-LTS release is superseded once a new feature release is made available. The Eclipse Temurin support page lists Java 22, 23, and 24 as EOSL, with end of availability in September 2024, March 2025, and September 2025.

rules.title: Java 26 is no longer supported
rules.summary: The Oracle Java SE Support Roadmap lists Java 26 as a non-LTS release whose Premier Support ended in September 2026. It says a previous non-LTS release is superseded once a new feature release is made available. The Eclipse Temurin support page lists Java 26 as EOSL, with end of availability in September 2026.

rules.title: mysql:mysql-connector-java has moved to com.mysql:mysql-connector-j
rules.summary: The POM of mysql:mysql-connector-java 8.0.33 declares a relocation to com.mysql:mysql-connector-j. Its message says: "MySQL Connector/J artifacts moved to reverse-DNS compliant Maven 2+ coordinates."

rules.title: org.slf4j:slf4j-log4j12 has moved to org.slf4j:slf4j-reload4j
rules.summary: The POM of org.slf4j:slf4j-log4j12 2.1.0-alpha1 declares a relocation to org.slf4j:slf4j-reload4j.
